40022428.author: पदार्थः
40022428.content: नारदस्य of Narada, तु indeed, तद्वाक्यं that speech, श्रुत्वा having heard, अमृतमयं nectar-like, तदा then, प्रहर्षमतुलं immeasurable joy, लेभे obtained, लक्ष्मणं to Lakshmana, च and, इदम् this, अब्रवीत् spoke

40022428.author: Translation
40022428.content: Then, having heard those nectar-like words of Narada, Rama obtained immeasurable joy and spoke this to Lakshmana.

40022429.author: पदार्थः
40022429.content: गच्छ go, सौम्य O gentle one, द्विजश्रेष्ठं the best of Brahmins, समाश्वासय console, सुव्रतम् the one of good vows, बालस्य of the child, तु indeed, शरीरं body, तत् that, तैलद्रोण्यां in a trough of oil, निधापय cause to be placed

40022429.author: Translation
40022429.content: O gentle one, go and console that best of Brahmins, the one of good vows, and have the child's body preserved in a trough of oil.

40022430.author: पदार्थः
40022430.content: गन्धैः with fragrances, च and, परमोदारैः very excellent, तैलैः with oils, च and, अपि also, सुगन्धिभिः fragrant, यथा so that, न not, क्षीयते wastes away, बालः the child, तथा so, सौम्य O gentle one, विधीयताम् let it be done

40022430.author: Translation
40022430.content: O gentle one, let it be done with very excellent fragrances and fragrant oils so that the child does not waste away.

40022431.author: पदार्थः
40022431.content: यथा so that, शरीरः the body, बालस्य of the child, गुप्तः protected, सन् being, शिष्टकर्मणः of the well-behaved one, विपत्तिः misfortune, परिभेदः injury, वा or, न not, भवेत् may occur, च and, तथा so, कुरु do

40022431.author: Translation
40022431.content: Ensure that the body of the well-behaved child is protected so that no misfortune or injury may occur.

40022432.author: पदार्थः
40022432.content: एवम् thus, आदिश्य having instructed, काकुत्स्थः Rama, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, शुभलक्षणम् auspicious-featured, मनसा with his mind, पुष्पकम् the Pushpaka, दध्यौ meditated upon, आगच्छ come, इति thus, महायशाः the highly renowned one

40022432.author: Translation
40022432.content: Having thus instructed the auspicious-featured Lakshmana, the highly renowned Rama thought of the Pushpaka chariot in his mind, commanding it to come.

40022433.author: पदार्थः
40022433.content: इङ्गितम् the hint, सः it, तु indeed, विज्ञाय having understood, पुष्पकः the Pushpaka, हेमभूषितः adorned with gold, आजगाम came, मुहूर्तेन in a moment, समीपे near, राघवस्य of Rama, वै indeed

40022433.author: Translation
40022433.content: Indeed, having understood Rama's mental signal, the gold-adorned Pushpaka chariot arrived near Rama in a moment.

40022434.author: पदार्थः
40022434.content: सः it, अब्रवीत् spoke, प्रणतः bowed, भूत्वा having become, अयम् this, अस्मि I am, नराधिप O king of men, वश्यः obedient, तव your, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, किङ्करः servant, समुपस्थितः present

40022434.author: Translation
40022434.content: Having bowed, the Pushpaka spoke, "O king of men, O mighty-armed one, I am your obedient servant, present here."

40022435.author: पदार्थः
40022435.content: भाषितं spoken words, रुचिरं pleasing, श्रुत्वा having heard, पुष्पकस्य of Pushpaka, नराधिपः the king, अभिवाद्य having saluted, महर्षींस्तान् those great sages, विमानं the aerial chariot, सः he, अध्यरोहत ascended.

40022435.author: Translation
40022435.content: Having heard the pleasing words of Pushpaka, the king (Rama) saluted those great sages and then ascended the aerial chariot.

40022436.author: पदार्थः
40022436.content: धनुः bow, गृहीत्वा having taken, तूणी quiver, च and, खड्गं sword, च and, रुचिरप्रभम् of beautiful luster, निक्षिप्य having left, नगरे in the city, वीरौ the two heroes, सौमित्रिभरतौ Lakshmana and Bharata, उभौ both.

40022436.author: Translation
40022436.content: Having taken his bow, quiver, and a beautifully shining sword, and having left both heroes Lakshmana and Bharata in the city, (Rama proceeded).

40022437.author: पदार्थः
40022437.content: प्रायात् he went, प्रतीचीं western, हरितं direction, विचिन्वंश्च and searching, ततस्ततः here and there, उत्तराम northern, अगमत् he went, श्रीमान् the glorious one, दिशं direction, हिमवता by the Himalayas, वृताम् covered.

40022437.author: Translation
40022437.content: The glorious Rama proceeded to the western direction, searching everywhere, and then went to the northern direction, which is covered by the Himalayas.

40022438.author: पदार्थः
40022438.content: अपश्यमानः not seeing, तत्रापि even there, स्वल्पमपि even a little, अथ then, दुष्कृतम् evil deed, पूर्वामपि even the eastern, दिशं direction, सर्वाम् entire, अथो then, अपश्यत् he saw, नराधिपः the king.

40022438.author: Translation
40022438.content: Not finding even a slight evil deed there (in the north), the king then surveyed the entire eastern direction as well.

40022439.author: पदार्थः
40022439.content: प्रविशुद्धसमाचाराम् whose conduct was perfectly pure, आदर्शतलनिर्मलाम् as clear as the surface of a mirror, पुष्पकस्थः seated in Pushpaka, महाबाहुः the mighty-armed one, तदा then, अपश्यत् he saw, नराधिपः the king.

40022439.author: Translation
40022439.content: Seated in Pushpaka, the mighty-armed king then saw (the entire land) whose conduct was perfectly pure and as clear as the surface of a mirror.

40022440.author: पदार्थः
40022440.content: दक्षिणां southern, दिशम् direction, आक्रामत् proceeded, ततः then, राजर्षिनन्दनः the son of the royal sage (Rama), शैवलस्य of Shaivala, उत्तरे northern, पार्श्वे side, ददर्श saw, सुमहत् very large, सरः lake.

40022440.author: Translation
40022440.content: Then, Rama, the son of the royal sage, proceeded towards the southern direction and on the northern side of Shaivala, he saw a very large lake.

40022441.author: पदार्थः
40022441.content: तस्मिन् in that, सरसि lake, तप्यन्तं performing penance, तापसं an ascetic, सुमहत् very great, तपः penance, ददर्श saw, राघवः Rama, श्रीमान् glorious, लम्बमानम् hanging, अधोमुखम् head downwards.

40022441.author: Translation
40022441.content: In that lake, the glorious Rama saw an ascetic performing very great penance, hanging head downwards.

40022442.author: पदार्थः
40022442.content: राघवः Rama, तम् him, उपागम्य having approached, तप्यन्तं performing, तपः penance, उत्तमम् excellent, उवाच said, सः he, तदा then, वाक्यं words, धन्यः blessed, त्वम् you, असि are, सुव्रत O ascetic of good vows.

40022442.author: Translation
40022442.content: Rama, having approached him who was performing excellent penance, then spoke these words: "O ascetic of good vows, you are blessed."

40022443.author: पदार्थः
40022443.content: कस्यां in which, योन्यां birth/species, तपोवृद्ध O venerable ascetic, वर्तसे you are, दृढविक्रम O one of firm resolve, कौतूहलात् out of curiosity, त्वां you, पृच्छामि I ask, रामः Rama, दाशरथिः son of Dasharatha, हि indeed, अहम् I.

40022443.author: Translation
40022443.content: "O venerable ascetic, in which birth or species do you exist, O one of firm resolve? I ask you out of curiosity, for I am Rama, the son of Dasharatha."

40022444.author: पदार्थः
40022444.content: कः what, अर्थः purpose, मनीषितः desired, तुभ्यं by you, स्वर्गलाभः attainment of heaven, परः supreme/other, अथवा or, वर boon, आश्रयः object/support, यदर्थं for which purpose, त्वं you, तपस्यसि perform penance, सुदुष्करम् very difficult, यम् whom/which, आश्रित्य having resorted to, तपः penance, तप्तं performed, श्रोतुम् to hear, इच्छामि I wish, तापस O ascetic.

40022444.author: Translation
40022444.content: "What is the purpose desired by you, is it the attainment of heaven or some other supreme boon, for which you are performing this very difficult penance, O ascetic? I wish to hear what you have resorted to for performing this penance."

40022445.author: पदार्थः
40022445.content: ब्राह्मणो A Brahmana, वा or, ऽसि you are, भद्रं welfare, ते to you, क्षत्रियो A Kshatriya, वा or, ऽसि you are, दुर्जयः unconquerable, वैश्यस्तृतीयवर्णो A Vaishya, the third varna, वा or, शूद्रो A Shudra, वा or, सत्यवाग्भव be truthful.

40022445.author: Translation
40022445.content: Rama asks the ascetic to truthfully state his varna, whether he is a Brahmana, a Kshatriya, a Vaishya, or a Shudra, wishing him well regardless.

40022446.author: पदार्थः
40022446.content: इत्येवमुक्तः thus spoken to, स he, नराधिपेन by the king, ह्यवाक्छिरा with head bowed down, दाशरथाय to Dasharatha's son (Rama), तस्मै to him, उवाच spoke, जातिं his caste, नृपपुङ्गवाय to the best of kings, यत्कारणे for what reason, च and, एव indeed, तपःप्रयत्नः the effort of penance.

40022446.author: Translation
40022446.content: Thus addressed by the king, the ascetic, with his head bowed, revealed his caste and the reason for his severe penance to Rama, the best of kings. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे पञ्चसप्ततितमः सर्गः ।। 75 ।। Thus ends the seventy-fifth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
